description: This Java interface defines mappings between internal data structures and API response objects for office-related endpoints in the Fineract project, using MapStruct for implementation code generation.

classes.name: OfficeSwaggerMapper
classes.description: A MapStruct mapper interface to convert service layer data objects into API response objects for office endpoints.

methods.name: toPutOfficesOfficeIdResponse
methods.description: Converts CommandProcessingResult to a Swagger API response object.

methods.name: toPutOfficesOfficeIdResponseChanges
methods.description: Creates a response change object from a map of field changes, specifically mapping the 'name' field.

methods.name: toGetOfficesResponse
methods.description: Converts OfficeData to a Swagger API response object for getting office data.
